where: The cold-open cinematic (the Long Dusk falls; a star winks out)
mood: The Long Dusk falling: hushed foreboding under a sky losing its lanterns, a fragile hopeful phrase that reaches up and is never answered.
core_styles: low dark string pad and soft drone
fragile high bell and soft pulse-wave lead fragment
foreboding, hushed, a little sorrowful with a thin thread of hope
spacious and uncluttered, lots of rests

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a hushed low A drone fades up from silence and one high bell note sounds alone like the last lantern in the sky}

sections.name: Theme
sections.text: {the fragile bell and soft lead play a hopeful rising leap that reaches past the tonic and is left hanging into rests, still searching for home; the low pad sighs beneath}

sections.name: Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the rising phrase again, a thin sustained string thread now joining underneath, the harmony darkening through F and the raised G sharp pulling toward E}

sections.name: The Lights Go Out
sections.text: {contrast: the stars fall one by one, a slow descending line in low strings over D minor, soft distant timpani strokes, the bell falls silent}

sections.name: Theme Return
sections.text: {the fragile rising phrase returns once more over the drone, still unanswered; the last bar rests on a low E that pulls straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
